create_csm_conditional_generation: create a CsmForConditionalGeneration model for audio-text multimodal generation with backbone and depth decoder
build_csm_backbone_model: build a CsmBackboneModel transformer that predicts the first codebook token from audio or text input
build_csm_depth_decoder: build a CsmDepthDecoderForCausalLM model that predicts remaining codebook tokens using backbone hidden states
test_csm_attention: test the CsmAttention module with multi-head attention, rotary embeddings, and KV cache support
review_csm_mlp: review the CsmMLP feedforward layer implementing gated linear units with gate_proj and up_proj
